description:
Experience Required: 


3+ years of full time experience building scalable web applications using PHP and MySQL with a general understanding of Smarty


Strong MySQL query and table building experience


Solid experience with cross-platform, browser compliant HTML (HTML5) and CSS


Good JavaScript knowledge (jQuery framework)


Experience with version control systems, especially GIT


Familiarity with integrating APIs, understanding of JSON, XML, SOAP


Attention to detail - clean code and precise design translation


Experience working in a team environment and documenting code


Experience building code for non sticky load balancing is a plus


Experience with AWS is a plus


Experience with Twitter Bootstrap a plus


 Skill :    PHP, MYSQL,HTML, CSS


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
